LAREDO — A 43-year-old man was booked into the Webb County Jail on Saturday afternoon on an alleged felony charge of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Gilbert Rodriguez was arrested on October 24, 2026, at 5:15 p.m. The booking record lists aggravated assault with a deadly weapon — a second-degree felony. Bond was set at $50,000.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
